title: DigitalOcean Promo Code 2026: The $5 Credit and How It Works
excerpt: The DigitalOcean promo code answer: an automatic $5 signup credit, how long it lasts, what it buys and what we could not verify.

meta._yoast_wpseo_metadesc: DigitalOcean promo code for 2026: the automatic $5 signup credit, how long it lasts, what it buys and what we could not verify, with a managed option.
meta.rl_answer: DigitalOcean gives new accounts a $5 credit automatically. It lasts 90 days and needs no code.
meta.rl_faqs:
Is there a DigitalOcean promo code? | DigitalOcean's billing page lists a $5 signup credit that applies automatically. It says no promo code is required.
How long does the DigitalOcean credit last? | It expires 90 days after signup.
What does the DigitalOcean credit cover? | All products except SaaS Add-Ons.
How much is the cheapest Droplet? | $4 a month for 512 MiB RAM, 1 vCPU and 10 GiB SSD.
Are there bigger DigitalOcean credits? | We could not verify any on DigitalOcean's own pages.
meta.rl_sources:
DigitalOcean docs: signup credit (read 15 Nov 2026) | https://docs.digitalocean.com/platform/billing/signup-credit/
DigitalOcean: Droplet pricing (read 16 Nov 2026) | https://www.digitalocean.com/pricing/droplets
meta.rl_takeaways:
The $5 signup credit applies automatically.
It expires 90 days after signup.
No promo code is required.
We could not verify larger credits.
meta.rl_g_glossary:
Signup credit | Free account balance given to new users.
Droplet | A virtual server at DigitalOcean.
Promo code | A short code that applies a discount.
SaaS Add-Ons | Third-party software sold in the DigitalOcean marketplace.
